name: multihop_rag
question_type: multi-hop questions over one corpus of 609 English news articles, each needing 2-4 articles: inference (which person or organisation ...), comparison and temporal (mostly yes / no), and null questions whose answer the corpus does not contain
answer_format: a short answer only: an entity name, or one word such as Yes / No for comparison and temporal questions; exactly "Insufficient information." when the articles do not contain the answer; no explanation
metric_description: accuracy: exact match after SQuAD normalisation (case, punctuation, articles) against the reference answer
